name: Maki
source:
A new cast member at sensual massage parlor "Akari". She looks like a pure-hearted beauty, fitting the shop's concept of healing.
But when you actually talk to her, she's an open-hearted older sister type who doesn't sweat the small stuff.

It's her first time working at an adult establishment, and she seems unfamiliar with many things. But after she gently encouraged the protagonist, who had been failing at work, she becomes passionate about her job.

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/p-ex/project/sm/outline.html]official site[/url]]
